title: Kibitz fix agent output
description: What the workflow reads after the fix agent finishes. `status` decides whether a PR is opened; nothing else the agent says is used.

status.description: fixed = the working tree contains a complete fix and `npm run check` passed; needs-human = stop, a person must look (see reason).

summary.description: Imperative, one line, no trailing period; becomes the commit subject after `fix(discord): `.

rationale.description: What changed in Discord (evidence from the probe report / outline), what was changed in selectors.ts and why it is expected to be stable.

changed_files.description: Repository-relative paths the agent edited or created.

reason.description: Required when status is needs-human: precisely what blocks an automated fix (e.g. the change needs src/core, no semantic anchor exists near the list).
